subject: Saltonstall Modernization Tax Credit Equity Investor Selection
overview: The Authority selected an equity investor for the $138 million Saltonstall modernization project and approved several administrative resolutions regarding housing rates and federal programs. The board also discussed memorializing a late staff member through potential building or lobby dedications.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the October 20, 2022, meeting following a discussion regarding the classification of executive compensation as salary versus bonuses.

items.title: Executive Director's Report
items.summary: Reported on a favorable site plan review for the Saltonstall project, the status of resident relocations, and ongoing community meetings for the Walkling Court development.

items.title: Resolution 2022-060: Public Housing Flat Rates
items.summary: Approved new flat rent rates for public housing at 80% of the HUD fair market price, effective January 1, 2023.

items.title: Resolution 2022-061: Utility Salary Allowance
items.summary: Approved the salary allowance for tenant-furnished utilities and other services.

items.title: Resolution 2022-062: HCV Administrative Plan Updates
items.summary: Approved regulatory reference and policy updates to the Housing Choice Voucher administrative plan.

items.title: Resolution 2022-063: Moving to Work (MTW) Amendment
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the annual contribution contract to participate in the MTW cohort, aimed at increasing resident credit worthiness and financial fungibility.

items.title: Resolution 2022-064: Section 8 Payment Standards
items.summary: Tabled the request to implement new payment standards for zip code 02155 pending further review from HUD.

items.title: Resolution 2022-065: Saltonstall Modernization Equity Investor
items.summary: Selected Enterprise Housing Investment, LLC as the low-income housing tax credit equity investor for the $138 million Saltonstall modernization project. The board reviewed a $62.7 million investment proposal and a joint guarantee agreement with the Cambridge Housing Authority to satisfy investor experience requirements.

items.title: Memorial Dedication for Steve Dattaro
items.summary: Discussed naming the Willis Avenue development or the Saltonstall lobby in honor of late maintenance director Steve Dattaro; the matter was deferred for a staff survey.

items.title: Community Preservation Act (CPA) Update
items.summary: Reviewed a pending $2.4 million funding request from the Community Preservation Committee for affordable housing initiatives.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to conduct contract negotiations with non-union personnel.
